''See also: [[Sandviper Gokren Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Gokren is the [[Truegold]] chief of the [[Sandviper sect]] and the father of Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral, a [[Highgold]]. A wiry man with slicked-back gray hair, he typically wears furs and carries two short, one-handed spears on his back. He utilizes the Sandvipers{{!}}Sandviper [[Path]], which draws [[madra]] from toxins, corrosion, and [[poison]], often manifesting as a bitter green light. As a leader, he is capable of commanding his people to hunt and has shown deep loyalty to those considered brothers to his son. During a hunting trip, he returned with various prizes and an ancient bracer for his son. However, during a confrontation involving the creature [[Orthos]], Gokren suffered catastrophic injuries, including the loss of his hand, leg, and eventually being consumed by the entity.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Gokren is a member of the [[Sandviper sect]] with gray hair. He possesses an acid-green Sandvipers{{!}}Sandviper resting on his arm and is missing a hand.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|As the [[Truegold]] and chief of the [[Sandvipers]], Gokren utilizes [[Forged madra]] from the [[Path of the Sandviper]]. His [[madra]] is described as bitter and foul, causing his short spear to glow green with toxic energy.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Soulsmith}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Although Gokren is initially noted as being absent from the [[Sandvipers]], he is later identified as the [[Truegold]] and chief of the group.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref> As a member of the [[Sandviper sect]], he is also the father of a [[Highgold]] son.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Blackflame}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Sandvipers{{!}}Sandviper Gokren is a Sandvipers{{!}}Sandviper who carries an acid-green Sandvipers{{!}}Sandviper on his arm and mourns the death of his son, who was an [[Iron]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2">''Blackflame'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c16">''Blackflame'', chapter 16</ref> As the [[Sandviper chief]], this gray-haired leader utilizes a short spear and [[Forged madra]] from the [[Path of the Sandviper]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c4">''Blackflame'', chapter 4</ref> His foul and bitter [[madra]] powers a spear that glows green with toxic energy.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c4" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19">''Blackflame'', chapter 19</ref> Gokren belongs to a sect that provides vehicles and mounts, and he personally rides a bat donated by the [[Jai clan]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6">''Blackflame'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8">''Blackflame'', chapter 8</ref> An associate of [[Jai Long]], Gokren eventually lost a hand to [[Lindon]]'s [[Path]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11">''Blackflame'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19" />}}
